def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(i,j,v) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v!=bg]
    from collections import Counter as C
    cc=C(v for _,_,v in cells)
    marker=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    stamp_cells=[(i,j,v) for i,j,v in cells if v!=marker]
    rs=[i for i,_,_ in stamp_cells]; cs=[j for _,j,_ in stamp_cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    stamp=[[g[i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    H,W=len(stamp),len(stamp[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    mr,mc=(r0+r1)//2,(c0+c1)//2  # stamp center in original
    for i,r in enumerate(g):
        for j,v in enumerate(r):
            if v==marker:
                # center stamp on (i,j): offset such that (mr,mc) maps to (i,j)
                dr,dc=i-mr,j-mc
                for a in range(H):
                    for b in range(W):
                        ri,rj=i-mr+a, j-mc+b
                        if 0<=ri<len(g) and 0<=rj<len(g[0]):
                            out[ri][rj]=stamp[a][b]

def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    vals=Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v!=bg)
    marker=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sc=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (bg,marker)]
    r0=min(i for i,_ in sc); r1=max(i for i,_ in sc)
    c0=min(j for _,j in sc); c1=max(j for _,j in sc)
    stamp=[[g[i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    H=len(stamp); W=len(stamp[0])
    mr,mc=(r0+r1)//2,(c0+c1)//2
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    markers=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==marker]
    for (mi,mj) in markers:
        for a in range(H):
            for b in range(W):
                ri=mi+(a-mr); rj=mj+(b-mc)
                if 0<=ri<len(g) and 0<=rj<len(g[0]):
                    out[ri][rj]=stamp[a][b]
    return out

        comps.append(comp)

def background(grid):
